scope: WYSIWYG CharacterStudio test migration and responsive/accessibility verification

executions.name: npm test
executions.result: 18 catalog/reference checks and remaining router, history, template, renderer, loader, extension, motion, publish-inventory and safety checks passed; no reported errors.

executions.name: test:editing
executions.result: All 12 Dots and 16 Grok legal recipes rendered/exported; two complete edit/export/original-download journeys, dirty-exit guards, thumbnail recovery, revision races and resource release checks passed. No console, browser or HTTP failures.

executions.name: studio browser
executions.result: 15 browser checks, 25 captures and 24 exact original downloads passed; no reported errors.

executions.name: studio contrast
executions.result: 296 rendered text targets passed paired-screenshot pixel contrast analysis on the final CSS; minimum ratio 5.567:1.

executions.name: editor layout
executions.result: 16 template, viewport and language combinations passed with 48 captures; mobile preview and canvas stayed fully visible during option changes, the 320 px option cards did not overlap the action row, and Export remained visible, enabled and pointer-accessible after scrolling. Closed mobile dialogs occupied no layout space.

failedAttempts.cause: The migrated test initially assumed hidden tab panels exposed their options, used an ambiguous nested summary selector, and returned a DOM node from page.evaluate instead of a serializable revision value.
failedAttempts.repair: Activated each category tab before testing options, selected the direct original disclosure summary, and compared the rendered canvas revision as a scalar. The final run above passed.

failedAttempts.cause: An initial max-scroll assertion required tabs to remain sticky after scrolling past the editor, original and Prompt content; this exceeded the requested mobile interaction scope. A paired screenshot also showed the action row covering part of the color card at 320 px.
failedAttempts.repair: Replaced the max-scroll assertion with real tab/option hit-testing during the selection flow. The CSS action row was moved to normal flow; the final layout run above verifies complete option visibility, preview visibility and reachable export.

failedAttempts.cause: The first migrated run compared the paired captures in reverse order and included a hidden Prompt node.
failedAttempts.repair: Corrected normal/masked capture ordering and restricted measurements to visible text. The final run above passed.

browserMethod: Automated interactions and downloads used the project Playwright runner with installed local Chrome. Codex in-app browser use was visual inspection only; no interaction pass is claimed.
limitations: No deployment or production-site acceptance is claimed.
